title_vi: Sáu mẫu quản lý dữ liệu: bản nào là gốc, bản nào là dẫn xuất

source_snapshot.note: Pinned commit/path body read from a partial clone of the source repository; git hash-object of the retrieved body matches the source-map blob. No source-image bytes used.

related.reason_vi: Event sourcing so với thiết kế ghi đè trạng thái.
Các bản dẫn xuất là một dạng nhất quán sau cùng.

claims.evidence: The Azure Architecture Center pattern pages for Cache-Aside, Materialized View, Index Table, CQRS, Event Sourcing and Sharding were read from a partial clone of MicrosoftDocs/architecture-center, and the PostgreSQL 16 rules.sgml materialized-view section from postgres/postgres; the stale-view numbers come from the author's run on PostgreSQL 16.15 on 2026-10-18.

mobile.evidence: Chromium (Playwright) rendered lesson.md (markdown-it, tables enabled, every <details> open, a 16 px page gutter) at each width: the page never scrolled sideways and the figure was scaled to the column; the smallest SVG font-size times that scale is the recorded minimum at 320 px. `python3 -m scripts.figures check --browser` measured every line of the figure in Chromium inside its box. Not GitHub, not a real phone and not learner testing.

claims.claim_vi: Cache-aside loads data on demand into the cache and invalidates the cached item when the application writes; it does not guarantee consistency between the store and the cache, e.g. an external process can change the store and the change only appears when the item loads again.
claims.verified_by: Read from a partial clone of MicrosoftDocs/architecture-center at commit 8e2c239344ee753a88856800b4210a3e27ac1036.

claims.claim_vi: A materialized view may serve stale results until refreshed; if the refresh signal is lost or delayed the view silently serves stale data, so monitor refresh recency.
claims.verified_by: Read from a partial clone of MicrosoftDocs/architecture-center at commit 8e2c239344ee753a88856800b4210a3e27ac1036.

claims.claim_vi: Index tables are lookup tables for stores without suitable secondary indexes; if source data and index entries cannot be updated in one transaction, design for eventual consistency.
claims.section: Context and problem; Problems and considerations
claims.verified_by: Read from a partial clone of MicrosoftDocs/architecture-center at commit 8e2c239344ee753a88856800b4210a3e27ac1036.

claims.claim_vi: CQRS separates the write model (commands, validation) from the read model; with separate stores the read model is eventually consistent with the write model.
claims.verified_by: Read from a partial clone of MicrosoftDocs/architecture-center at commit 8e2c239344ee753a88856800b4210a3e27ac1036.

claims.claim_vi: Event sourcing records each event in an append-only store and derives current state by replaying the stream; because replay is costly, applications typically implement materialized views.
claims.verified_by: Read from a partial clone of MicrosoftDocs/architecture-center at commit 8e2c239344ee753a88856800b4210a3e27ac1036.

claims.claim_vi: Hash-based sharding reduces hotspots, shards that receive a disproportionate share of load; virtual shards reduce the impact of rebalancing; range sharding needs split and merge operations to rebalance.
claims.verified_by: Read from a partial clone of MicrosoftDocs/architecture-center at commit 8e2c239344ee753a88856800b4210a3e27ac1036 after a review finding on PR #144.

claims.claim_vi: An effective shard key is immutable, has high cardinality, distributes data and load evenly and aligns with dominant query patterns so most requests resolve against a single shard.
claims.verified_by: Read from a partial clone of MicrosoftDocs/architecture-center at commit 8e2c239344ee753a88856800b4210a3e27ac1036.

claims.claim_vi: PostgreSQL materialized views persist results in table-like form; access is often much faster but the data is not always current. Measured on PostgreSQL 16.15: the view showed 70 for 2026-10-18 after the table total became 100, and 100 after REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW.
claims.verified_by: Read from a partial clone of postgres/postgres at REL_16_STABLE commit 8e928803020e5b5694cde58e4851fce64ef9d520; the author ran the experiment and measured the view on 2026-10-18.

claims.claim_vi: Six data management patterns: cache aside, materialized view, CQRS, event sourcing, index table, sharding.

design_notes_vi: Hai nhóm ba mẫu (thêm bản dẫn xuất, đổi cách lưu), câu hỏi về độ cũ chỉ áp cho bản dẫn xuất, sharding có lo ngại riêng; một số đo từ thử nghiệm materialized view. Không dùng ảnh nguồn.
source_deviations: The source gives one descriptive paragraph per pattern; the lesson sorts them by whether they add a derived copy or split the original, asks the staleness question only of derived copies (CQRS with separate stores, event-sourcing projections included) and gives sharding its own concerns, from the Azure pattern pages.
The lesson adds a measured stale materialized view on PostgreSQL.
editorial_note_vi: Bài mới viết trong kho này, chờ review kỹ thuật. Chưa user testing hoặc phê duyệt phát hành.
